risks.t: among other things, volatility in the price of PAVmed’s and Lucid’s common stock
the uncertainties inherent in research and development, including the cost and time required to advance PAVmed’s and Lucid’s products to regulatory submission
whether regulatory authorities will be satisfied with the design of and results from PAVmed’s and Lucid’s clinical and preclinical studies
whether and when PAVmed’s and Lucid’s products are cleared by regulatory authorities
market acceptance of PAVmed’s and Lucid’s products once cleared and commercialized
PAVmed’s and Lucid’s ability to raise additional funding as needed
